meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Level energies are the NIST ASD values (data/nist/As_I_levels.tsv). 75As has I = 3/2 and is the only stable isotope. The two resonance-line A values are derived from the absorption oscillator strengths printed by Bengtsson et al. (their laser lifetimes combined with the branching ratios of Lotrian et al. 1980); NIST ASD already lists the same numbers. Hyperfine A constants of the 4p3 2D, 2P levels are second-hand (Bouazza et al. 1987 as quoted by Liu et al. 2023); note the large uncertainty of 2P°3/2. Lifetimes of the 4p3 metastable levels and all forbidden-line rates are THEORY. In the forbidden-line entries A_s is the sum of the calculated M1 and E2 rates and the note gives both parts. Added 2026-10-01 (second pass): magnetic hyperfine constants A of the seven 4p2 5s levels (Bouazza et al. 1987, printed in mK and converted here, 1 mK = 29.979 MHz); 29 measured branching fractions of the 4p2 5s - 4p3 lines (Berzins et al. 2021, open-access copy on the University of Latvia server) and A values for the seven weak branches of the two laser-measured levels; second-hand beam-foil lifetimes for 4P5/2, 2P1/2, 2P3/2, 2D5/2 and a second-hand theory lifetime for 2D3/2. Berzins et al. print A as 'mantissa (power of ten)', e.g. '127 (5)' = 1.27e7 s^-1. Caveat on Bouazza Table 2: the row labels were read from a damaged OCR layer of the scan (rows in printed order: 4P1/2, 2P1/2, 4P3/2, 2P3/2, 2D3/2, 4P5/2, 2D5/2); the 4P3/2 and 2P3/2 labels are the least certain. Transitions between the quartet and doublet systems are typed 'intercombination'.
